title: A note on the classification of simple $SL_2(\bar{\mathbb{F}}_p)$-modules admitting $\bf T$-stable lines in cross characteristic
summary: Let $\bf T$ be the group of diagonal matrices in $SL_2(\bar{\mathbb{F}}_p)$, where $p$ is a prime number. Let $\Bbbk$ be an algebraically closed field of characteristic not equal to $2$ and $p$. We classify all the irreducible $\Bbbk$-representations of $SL_2(\bar{\mathbb{F}}_p)$ that admit $\bf T$-stable lines.
